title: gentianella acuta subsp. plebeia
intro: Gentianella acuta subsp. plebeia, commonly known as Alpine Gentian, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve gastrointestinal issues, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents of Gentianella acuta subsp. plebeia include iridoid glycosides, such as gentiopicroside and swertiamarin, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
